notes.text: Remove "no scene on the table"; instead, blank out the entire stage with a "(No Active Scene)" notification in the center whenever a scene is not active.
Scenes on deck should display in the same order that they appear in the scenes popup modal

When transitioning to a scene set to "Table B" with an NPC occupying slot 6, the error "slot 6 is too big for this table" appears.  But Table B is meant to dynamically choose from Table B0 to Table B5 depending on the number of occupied slots.
When a pinned note is edited on the dashboard, it should collapse back to its pin when clicked off of.
Right-clicking on a category name should allow editing the name of the group.

Right-clicking a token (not a token group) should bring up a configuration modal where I can rename the token, change its color, adjust the positioning of the figurine within the token circle, change the 'card scale' of the NPC (i.e. the scale value that defaults to 53), and set its seated y-value to a custom value that differs from the default.

NPC tokens added to the stage control board should be arranged in horizontal rows, scaled to 1.5, 1, 1.5, and separated by 3 units in the x-direction, with an extra 1-unit gap separating tokens in different groups --- i.e. they shouldn't spawn in their slot positions, as the stage control board is only being used for spotlight purposes moving forward.  Also, their y-rotation should be 0, not 180.  Changing their light mode from on to off (or vice versa) should still flip their token over, but not change its x/z position.

Some of the links for District and Site card images on the Dashboard appear to be broken. Check the build script to see how District/Site cards are extracted from the save,  and grab the URLs from there (as the custom assets in the save JSON have correct URLs)
During the spotlight phase, the stage board should be replaced with a scaled-up view of the spotlight carousel controls, centered, instead of having them appear in this top banner
Let's consolidate the popout/hide behavior of the roster to use the same click button to show it as to hide it (i.e. no more show-on-hover)

Add a small strip to the scene transition modal depicting all seated characters in the scene being departed from, that I can use to toggle on/off those characters who will be present in the scene being moved to. If there is a collision between the current seated characters and those declared in the scene library as seated in the coming scene, the destination layout gets priority, but any 'orphaned' seated characters should be displayed as tokens ringed in red off of the strip, and I should be able to drag those orphans to seats (swapping with any seated characters already there, moving them to the orphaned zone).  NPCs (not PCs) should also be draggable off of the strip, so they can be orphaned and 'left behind' so they don't occupy a seat in the new scene.
On a willpower reroll of a secret ST roll, the dice should be made visible again as they are rerolled, then hidden again before they land.
After an NPC reroll, the Dashboard dice are not updated to the new result (I have to click the 'recalculate' button to update them)
When I add notes on the righthand side of the screen, they overflow to the right -- the note input box should align itself so it doesn't overflow
Remove the word "Drawer" from the ST dice drawer display; a number in a box is enough and will prevent wrapping to two lines when collapsed.
When a roll is broadcast, it should automatically collapse on the Dashboard display.

When a secret roll is broadcast, the dice displayed should only include dice that rolled a success or a critical. If the result was a messy critical, ALL of the displayed dice should appear as hunger dice. If the result was a bestial failure, successful/critically successful dice should display as normal dice, and then any hunger dice that rolled a 1 should also be displayed. If the result is a total failure, no dice should be displayed.  Finally, the physical dice rolled during a secret roll should never be made visible to the players.
Resonance modifiers should not wrap, but be allowed to overflow to the left.
When dragging an NPC token from a lit/active seated position to the stage, the Dashboard shows them lit (as it should) but, in game, their figurine remains unlit

I'd like to be able to easily access each PC's character sheet (on the PCs tab) from the seated characters panel. Ideally, a double-click should bring me to the PCs tab with that character's sheet loaded; if combining a double-click with the existing single-click functionality would be problematic, a button on the left-click popup will work just as well

I'm unable to drag the moon to set the time when the clock is running on scene time; not sure if it's been disabled, or if the present day time display is blocking clicks, but it should be possible to advance the clock forward regardless of whether the clock is running on present day or scene time

I would like there to be a badge displayed over PCs that have active Compulsions, and ideally, a tooltip popup containing the Influence, Burden and Catharsis text for the compulsion drawn. Please check Google Drive for the Toronto Rising spreadsheets that contain this information; the GM notes on each drawn Compulsion card can be referenced to identify the compulsion drawn.
